pr_title: GameEngine: add context-efficient authoring capability discovery
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds registry-derived `authoring.list` compact discovery while retaining the full `authoring.capabilities` compatibility response. MCP and CLI share the canonical summary projection, and `authoring.describe` remains the on-demand full contract lookup.

## Validation

Use the repository Windows Validation workflow with impact-based affected planning. No UI changes are included, so Visual Validation is not required.
